archive_integrity_check: Exact byte size and MD5 matched the pinned Kaggle archive; every required member was read while validating the descriptor crosswalk and extracting features.
claim_boundary: Real 75-frame foil pose sequences derived from public YouTube competition videos. The archive has an unknown license and remains local-only. Forty-two repeated source-video windows are excluded from training. Evaluation must group all clips from the same one of 1,332 source videos. Outcome codes are preserved without claiming an undocumented left/right ordering, and scoring-light fields are not eligible model inputs. Athlete identities are unavailable, so video-group holdout is not proof of athlete-independent generalization.
